summary: A short event listing for a Charter Workplace Summit 2026 session on workplace AI. The blurb describes a panel in which leaders who track emerging AI tools and investors backing companies at the cutting edge of work discuss the most advanced use cases for AI. Stated session content includes common mistakes organizations make when adopting AI, pro tips drawn from the most pioneering people and organizations, and examples of the most innovative ways the panelists' own teams are using AI internally. No findings, data, products, or vendor categories are described in the text provided. Speakers listed are Roy Bahat, Head of Bloomberg Beta, and Kate Lee, Editor-in-chief of Every, with Kevin Delaney, Co-founder and editor-in-chief of Charter, moderating. The item is promotional conference programming copy rather than reporting, so it contains no verifiable claims, statistics, or workplace operations detail relevant to visitor management, space booking, hybrid policy, or facilities. Its only value for a listening pipeline is as a signal that Charter is programming workplace AI adoption as a summit-level theme for 2026 and that it is framing the conversation around internal team usage and adoption pitfalls rather than around infrastructure, governance, or procurement.
